authorship.humanDirection: Low-altitude F-22 temperate woodland readability with exact Web and Unity reuse

assets.role: alpha-tested temperate woodland, windbreak, hedgerow and meadow-scrub atlas
regionsTopLeftClockwise: low meadow scrub and wild grasses
constraints: presentation only; never terrain, collision, targeting, obstacle, route or visibility authority
the same atlas regions and physical scale contract must be consumed by Web and Unity
sRGB colour with ordinary mipmaps, straight alpha and alpha cutoff 0.38
authored UV origin is top-left with V increasing downward
no identifiable real-world location, sign, brand, person or vehicle
assets.prompt: Create a production-ready square 2x2 foliage sprite atlas for a low-altitude flight simulator set in a fictional temperate Eastern European / Ukrainian countryside. Four isolated orthographic side-view assets: a mature deciduous woodland clump, a tall narrow poplar windbreak cluster, a dense mixed hedgerow and young woodland mass, and low meadow scrub with wild grasses and small bushes. Painterly-realistic game art, believable green/sage/olive/brown variation, readable branching and leaf masses, neutral overcast lighting, no cast shadow, ground plane, sky, horizon, buildings, people, vehicles, text, border or grid. Final source plate uses a perfectly flat pure-blue chroma background for deterministic alpha extraction.

source.modelBackend: OpenAI built-in image generation; exact backend and seed not exposed
